cases.text: Hello... I'm a cat trying to learn how to playfully and happily use my own toys when it comes to interacting with other creatures. I also need help understanding and interpreting the signs & reactions of people who interact with them. It's all new to me, though. What kind of challenges do you come up against? And what do you think about it lately?
*sigh*...it's just too much work, it always seems that way. But, hey, I'm doing this to help you get over it – and hopefully, to make things better. Is everything okay?

.....I am lost. I'm stuck here. I don't know where to go if I do. But.........maybe, maybe not......but I think it's there somewhere. Maybe its one of my dreams....or maybe it just goes nowhere............but nothing!..this is the worst part..its so hard!!..can be frustrating!! :( i really need help..

cases.message: why do you hate my shoes?
cases.text: I don't like it so much - they're too... hard on their feet! I'm afraid to put them on while walking outside; they always fall off after a few steps! And they're quite heavy, that's why they make me want to keep 'em on when we go out. Can't help myself if she asks about what kind of clothes she could wear on her own boots ;
